notes: Pirates and plunder: kegs, a sack of plunder and dice for the core; the rares are the gun deck, a pirate hoard, a plunder chest, Harbour Row (hanging wharf-side shop signs) and an anchor with rope. All are drawn to look like a pirate's haul or a buccaneer's wharf, with no real function.

entries.why: Sack of plunder, a heap of coin and loot
Barrel-head dice and a bottle, a sailors' game
Gun Deck Station, 2x3 cannon with shot and keg
Pirate hoard, 2x2 chest and jewelled coin
Harbour Row, 4x1 hanging signs of the wharf-side shops
Anchor with coiled rope, a buccaneer's trophy
